hero.title: Quiz to learn. Rival to excel.
hero.intro: Two tracks, one name: <quiz>Quiz</quiz> any of 50 subjects at your own pace, or turn it into a <rivalry>Rivalry</rivalry> and challenge a friend.

learn.title: <quiz>Quiz</quiz> – learn at leisure
learn.body: Pick any of 50 subjects at your own level. No clock, no rival – just you and the subject.

rival.title: <rivalry>Rivalry</rivalry> – race to excel
rival.body: Send the same quiz to a friend – the higher score wins. The Prophet (peace be upon him) raced Aisha (RA) and said “This is for that”: friendly competition is Sunnah.

surah.title: Surah-Quiz
surah.subtitle: Focus on vocabulary from a specific Surah
surah.description: Learn vocabulary from specific Surahs. Browse through Surahs in KALAM to study their context, meaning, and rulings. Self-test your knowledge on the 39 completed Surahs in KALAM, without entry into a Leaderboard.
surah.note: Surah quizzes are also available in the KALAM app as Easy or Translation-only quizzes, and in IQRA as an Expert version with Translation, Tafsir and Vocabulary quizzes.

players.title: IQRA Players
players.subtitle: Find a player and challenge them
players.ranking: Ranked by total points, then best %

vocab.title: Arabic Vocabulary
vocab.lede: Choose the vocabulary that matches your learning goal. Each track opens the Vocabulary section on the Subjects page.

quranic.title: Quranic Arabic Vocabulary
quranic.subtitle: Understand the words of the Qur’an
quranic.description: Practise words and expressions found in the Qur’an, with meanings and Quranic context as the vocabulary collection grows.

modern.title: Modern Arabic Vocabulary
modern.subtitle: Build contemporary Arabic vocabulary
modern.description: Practise Modern Standard Arabic words for reading, writing, and everyday communication, with practical examples as they are added.

vocab.note: Both the Arabic Vocabulary and Surah Quiz buttons lead to self-learning tracks. For challenges, go to the <link>Challenges</link> page.

noDonations.title: No Donations & Charity
noDonations.body: IQRA and KALAM apps are built without charity, zakat, or donations – a practice aligned with the true Sunnah of the Noble Prophets, and the Righteous.
noDonations.verse: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
noDonations.translation: Say, "I do not ask you for this any payment, and I am not of the pretentious" — Surah Sad 38:86.

legacy.title: Welcome to the Islamic Knowledge Hub
legacy.subtitle: Explore and enhance your understanding of Islam through our interactive learning and gaming.

learn.title: IQRA Learning Mode
learn.description: Learn at your own pace with our comprehensive Islamic knowledge quiz system
learn.body: The IQRA learning mode provides a structured approach to learning about various aspects of Islam. Test your knowledge, learn from explanations, and track your progress across different subjects.
learn.p5: Introduced interactive Surah quizzes and dedicated Tamil sections

challenge.title: IQRA Challenge Mode
challenge.description: Test your knowledge and compete with others in timed challenges
challenge.body: The IQRA challenge mode puts your Islamic knowledge to the test with timed quizzes and competitive leaderboards. Challenge yourself and others to see who has the best understanding of Islamic topics.
